metadata.name: Aalen Germany Remote Sensing Observations (1984‑2023)
metadata.description: A single‑site collection of remote‑sensing observations for Aalen, Germany. The dataset contains 288 records of two types: raster entries with GeoTIFF files and associated observation start/end dates, and vector entries with Shapefile references. Each record includes the observation year, content description, file type, and constant geographic coordinates (latitude 48.79899472 N, longitude 9.998824433 E). The `Date/Time` column is a constant placeholder (always 1985‑05‑01) and is not part of the temporal coverage. Raster records span from 1984‑08‑01 to 2023‑10‑31.
